summary: Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing a planned Greek corporate bond offering of up to €100 million (up to 100,000 bonds, €1,000 nominal each, 5-year term) to be listed on Euronext Athens. The offer is not registered in the U.S. and is not directed to U.S. persons. No pricing, interest rate, or underwriting details are provided. The company cautions that completion is not assured. This is a standard offshore debt capital markets activity with no special-situations event such as a tender, restructuring, or change of control. What to watch: successful execution and pricing of the bond.
